title: 第13章 两败俱伤(下)第14章 神兵暗之殇
content_zh:
第十三章两败俱伤 下
瞬间7,8个炙热的火球就在黄金比蒙那庞大的身体上炸开了，冲在前面的武士看到自己的队伍偷袭成功，原本畏惧的心里顿时减少了少许。一个个卯足了力量向着那受伤的黄金比蒙砍去。
“当，当，当，当.....”众人看着自己的武器打在黄金比蒙的身上犹如打在钢铁上面一般，都惊讶的迟缓了片刻。也就是这短短的片刻时间。受到众人骚扰的黄金比蒙，立即掉头，看着在自己眼中犹如蝼蚁一般的家伙都敢冒犯自己。
一股王者的威严被侵犯的怒火在他的体内点燃。举起那只剩下的左手重力挥出。
“咚，”冲在最前面的一人，立即被那黄金比蒙砸成了肉酱。鲜血洒满了大地。见识到了这只黄金比蒙的凶恶，这些选中者拔腿就跑，据叶宇轩观察，不少选中者的速度都十分的迅捷，应该都加了基本步法。
这样作为团队肉盾的家伙一股脑的逃跑了，不要想，那些释放火球的法师类型的选中者也将不再发射火球，而是在那个男子的率领下，转身向后跑去。
看着眼前滑稽的一幕，叶宇轩忍不住在脸上露出一丝微笑。如果不是在这样一个世界，叶宇轩真会认为那些家伙是来表演的，给观众舒缓一下心情。
看着那些挑衅自己的人，都在想着四面八方逃跑。黄金比蒙怒吼一声，右脚一踏，方圆30米内一震剧烈的震动，所有身在其中的选中者都是一晕，大约持续了两秒之后才恢复清醒。
而这时黄金比蒙已经展开了他的大屠杀，左拳不停的挥出，好像一个永远不会停止的机器一般，但是这，对于这些第一次进入此空间的选中者来说，简直犹如恶梦一般。看着身旁的队友一个个被残忍的砸死，而且还不能得知下一个会是谁，自己又能幸运到几时。
看着偷袭自己的蝼蚁一个个的死在自己的手下，，黄金比蒙愤怒的心情终于得到了一丝缓解。彻底解决掉周围的蝼蚁之后，黄金比蒙终于向着那个一直趴在地上喘息的黑环巨蟒移去。看着他缓慢的行走步伐，叶宇轩不得不承认这些活了千年之久的老家伙的智慧一点也不低于人类。
5丈，4丈，3丈，叶宇轩默默的计算着黄金比蒙与黑环巨蟒的距离。就在他们相距3丈的那一瞬间，黄金比蒙突然提高自身的速度。形如鬼魅，眨眼之间便冲到了黑环巨蟒的身前，伸出它那粗壮的黄金左手，运起体内的剩余的黄金能量于左手之上，带着一股惊天动地的毁灭气息，对着黑环巨蟒的脖颈打出。
感受着这一拳中所蕴涵的强烈能量波动。叶宇轩丝毫不怀疑，这一拳如果打中黑环巨蟒后，他死亡的几率。
说时迟，那时快，就在叶宇轩等想要做收渔翁之利人，认为黑环巨蟒必死的一刻。一直瘫在地上的黑环巨蟒，突然怒吼一声，那巨大的蟒蛇脑袋陡然就移动到黄金比猛的面前，那血盆大口突兀地张开，向着黄金比蒙的身体咬去。
看着他一往无前的攻势，叶宇轩立即猜出了黑环巨蟒的心思，想要和黄金比蒙同归于尽了。同时叶宇轩右手紧紧的握住乌木剑，随时准备着偷袭，
活了千年之久的黄金比蒙凭借着他多年在战斗中生死边缘徘徊的经历，感应到身后的攻击虽然比较强大，但是对自己的威胁应该还没有到达那种地步。
在看一眼即将死于自己左手之下的黑环巨蟒，和自己已经折断了的右臂。黄金比蒙一狠心，决定不论付出多大的代价也要致其余死地。没有收手，无视身后的攻击，不顾一切的将自己的拳头砸了上去。
“轰”，在众人的眼中，黑环巨莽的脖颈立即被砸烂，头颅和身体直接分开，鲜血洒遍天空，看着这血腥的场面，叶宇轩没有丝毫的反应，依旧冷静的注视着场中的情景，同时右眼的余光瞟了一眼自己身旁树上的那对男女。
令他惊奇的是，这两人对于这漫天的飞血也没有丝毫的反应。这一情况，让叶宇轩对这两人的关注立即加深。
这时，虽然黑环巨蟒的蛇头与身体分了家，但是他毕竟是活了千年之久的老怪物，居然还没有死去，蛇头依然可以动，在他意念和仇恨的控制下继续向着黄金比蒙的身体咬去。
如此快的速度，再加上黄金比蒙为了杀死黑环巨蟒而没有防御，让着蛇头的毒牙直接咬到了他的后背，嘴中的毒液顺着他的血液进入了他的身体。

看着自己成功的将毒液注射进黄金比蒙的身体，黑环巨蟒的头终于倒在了地上。那充满仇恨的双眼死死的盯着黄金比蒙，口中断断续续的说道：“你...你也有今天，哈哈....哈哈。我..终于..报仇了。你陪我...一起死吧。”
听着黑环巨蟒断断续续的话语，黄金比蒙突然大笑了起来，带着无比强烈的自信说道：“你，就凭你的毒液也能破了我黄金血脉抗毒效果吗。千年之前不就已经试过，只要给我几天的调息时间。完全可以逼出你注入进我身体里面的毒液。这样你还凭什么说杀死我？”
“呵呵，你..你等着，你认为...如果...我没有...充足的准备....会引你出来。”黑环巨蟒虚弱的说道，但是那低沉的声音中却带着无尽的自信。
好像上天为了印证黑环巨蟒的话语一般，在黄金比蒙刚刚要说话反驳的时刻，后背突然剧烈的疼痛起来。
“噗，”一口鲜血直接从口中吐出。看着黄金比蒙的样子，黑环巨蟒的头颅突然振作了起来，好像只是受了点小伤一般，但是大家都知道，这只不过是死亡之前的回光返照。
带着胜利，满足，激动，报复的心态，黑环巨蟒讽刺的说道：“你，世上最强大的陆地战士，黄金比蒙也会有这一天啊，正是莫大的讽刺啊，哈哈，哈哈，能和黄金比蒙死在同一天，真是我的荣幸啊。

Chapter 13: Both sides suffer, Part 2
In an instant, 7 or 8 hot fireballs exploded on Golden Behemoth's huge body. The warriors who rushed in front saw that their team's sneak attack was successful, and their original fear suddenly reduced a little. One by one, they used all their strength to chop at the injured Golden Behemoth.
"Dang, Dang, Dang, Dang..." Everyone watched their weapons hitting Golden Behemoth's body as if they were hitting steel, and they all hesitated for a moment in surprise. That is this short moment. Golden Behemoth, who was harassed by everyone, immediately turned around and saw that the guy who was like an ant in his eyes dared to offend him.
A rage of kingly majesty being violated ignited in his body. He raised his remaining left hand and swung it with gravity.
"Boom," the person at the front was immediately smashed into pieces by the golden Behemoth. Blood spread all over the ground. Seeing the ferocity of this golden Behemoth, these chosen ones ran away. According to Ye Yuxuan's observation, many of the chosen ones were very fast, and they should have added basic footwork.
In this way, the guys who were the team's human shields all ran away. Don't think about it. Those chosen by the mage type who released fireballs would no longer shoot fireballs. Instead, they would turn around and run back under the leadership of that man.
Seeing the funny scene in front of him, Ye Yuxuan couldn't help but reveal a smile on his face. If it weren't for such a world, Ye Yuxuan would really think that those guys were here to perform and relieve the audience's mood.
Looking at those who provoked him, they were thinking of escaping in all directions. Golden Behemoth roared angrily and stepped with his right foot, causing a violent vibration within a 30-meter radius. All the chosen ones inside were stunned, and it lasted for about two seconds before they regained consciousness.
At this time, Golden Behemoth had already launched his massacre, and his left fist kept swinging out, like a machine that would never stop. But this, for these chosen ones who entered this space for the first time, was simply like a nightmare. Watching the teammates around him being brutally smashed to death one by one, and not knowing who will be next, how long can he be lucky?
Watching the ants that sneaked up on him die one by one at his hands, Golden Behemoth's angry mood finally eased. After completely eliminating the surrounding ants, Golden Behemoth finally moved towards the black-ringed python that had been lying on the ground panting. Looking at his slow walking pace, Ye Yuxuan had to admit that the wisdom of these old guys who had lived for thousands of years was not inferior to humans at all.
5 feet, 4 feet, 3 feet, Ye Yuxuan silently calculated the distance between the golden Behemoth and the black-ringed python. At the moment when they were 3 feet apart, Golden Behemoth suddenly increased his speed. Like a ghost, it rushed in front of the black-ringed python in the blink of an eye, stretched out its thick golden left hand, mobilized the remaining golden energy in the body on the left hand, and hit the neck of the black-ringed python with an earth-shattering aura of destruction.
Feel the strong energy fluctuation contained in this punch. Ye Yuxuan had no doubt that if this punch hit the black-ringed python, he would be more likely to die.
It was too late, but it was soon, at the moment when Ye Yuxuan and other people who wanted to take advantage of the situation thought that the black-ringed python would die. The black-ringed giant python that had been paralyzed on the ground suddenly roared, and the huge python head suddenly moved in front of Huang Jinbi Meng, and its bloody mouth suddenly opened and bit into Huang Jinbimeng's body.
Seeing his indomitable offensive, Ye Yuxuan immediately guessed the thoughts of the black-ringed python and wanted to die together with the golden Behemoth. At the same time, Ye Yuxuan held the ebony sword tightly in his right hand, ready for a sneak attack at any time.
Golden Behemoth, who has lived for thousands of years, relies on his many years of experience wandering on the edge of life and death in battles, and he senses that although the attack behind him is relatively powerful, the threat to him should not have reached that level yet.He took a look at the black-ringed python that was about to die under his left hand, and his broken right arm. Golden Behemoth was cruel and decided to kill others no matter how much he paid. He didn't stop, ignoring the attack from behind, and smashed his fist up desperately.
"Boom", in the eyes of everyone, the neck of the black-ringed giant was immediately smashed, the head and body were directly separated, and blood spread all over the sky. Looking at this bloody scene, Ye Yuxuan did not react at all, and still watched the scene calmly. At the same time, he glanced at the man and woman on the tree next to him from the corner of his right eye.
What surprised him was that these two people didn't react at all to the flying blood in the sky. This situation immediately made Ye Yuxuan pay more attention to these two people.
At this time, although the snake head of the black-ringed python was separated from the body, he was an old monster that had lived for thousands of years after all. He was not dead yet. The snake head could still move and continued to bite the golden Behemoth's body under the control of his thoughts and hatred.
Such a fast speed, coupled with the fact that Golden Behemoth had no defense in order to kill the black-ringed python, allowed the fangs on the snake's head to bite his back directly, and the venom in his mouth entered his body along with his blood.
Seeing that he had successfully injected venom into Golden Behemoth's body, the black-ringed python's head finally fell to the ground. The eyes full of hatred stared at Golden Behemoth, and said intermittently: "You...you also have today, haha...haha. I...finally...revenge. You accompany me...die together."
Listening to the intermittent words of the black-ringed python, Golden Behemoth suddenly laughed and said with extremely strong confidence: "Can you, just with your venom, break the anti-venom effect of my golden bloodline? Didn't you already try it a thousand years ago? As long as you give me a few days to adjust my breath, you can completely force out the venom you injected into my body. Why do you still say you will kill me?"
"Haha, you...you wait, do you think...if...I am not...sufficiently prepared...I will lure you out." The black-ringed python said weakly, but there was endless confidence in its deep voice.
As if God was trying to confirm the words of the black-ringed python, just when Golden Behemoth was about to speak to refute, severe pain suddenly began to hit his back.
"Pfft," a mouthful of blood spit out directly from his mouth. Looking at the appearance of Golden Behemoth, the head of the black-ringed python suddenly perked up, as if it was only slightly injured, but everyone knew that this was just a flashback before death.
With a mentality of victory, satisfaction, excitement, and revenge, the black-ringed python said sarcastically: "You, the most powerful land warrior in the world, Golden Behemoth will also have this day, it is a great irony, haha, haha, it is really an honor for me to die on the same day as Golden Behemoth.
